files.purpose: The whole Cmd-K style command palette overlay: a dimmed full-bleed scrim plus a 600pt wide glass panel holding one search field and up to 12 result rows that mix built-in actions, recent non-archived threads and (only while searching) project rows that start a new thread in that project. It owns the query text, the keyboard/hover selection index, the cached row array and the dismissal path back through AppModel.isCommandPalettePresented.
key_symbols: private struct ResultsKey: Equatable (fields: query: String, threads: [ChatThread], projects: [Project], selectedThreadID: UUID?, finishActionTitle: String)
private struct Item: Identifiable (fields: id: String, title: String, subtitle: String?, icon: ProjectIcon?, symbol: String, shortcut: String?, perform: () -> Void)
private func row(_ item: Item, isSelected: Bool) -> some View
calls_into: AppModel via @Environment(AppModel.self): model.threads, model.projects, model.selectedThreadID (read and written), model.finishActionTitle, model.finishActionSymbol, model.isCommandPalettePresented, model.newThread(), model.newThread(workspace: .worktree), model.newThread(in: project), model.chooseProjectFolder(), model.finishSelectedThread(), model.runtime(for: threadID), model.project(thread.projectID)
thread runtime object returned by model.runtime(for:): runtime.isTerminalVisible.toggle(), runtime.toggleDiff()
ProjectIcon type (Item.icon), Project (id, name, path, icon), ChatThread (id, title, projectID, updatedAt, isArchived, isInPanel)
SwiftUI: TextField, Image(systemName:), glassEffect(_:in:), onKeyPress, FocusState, Environment(\.colorScheme)
state_owned: @State private var query = "" (search text, starts empty)
@State private var selection = 0 (index of the highlighted row; reset to 0 on every query change)
@State private var items: [Item] = [] (cached result rows, rebuilt only when ResultsKey changes, explicitly so arrow keys and selection changes do not rebuild the list)
@FocusState private var isFocused: Bool (search field focus, set true in onAppear)
@Environment(\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme (drives the scrim opacity)
side_effects: Mutates AppModel: sets model.selectedThreadID when a thread row runs; sets model.isCommandPalettePresented = false in close()
Triggers thread creation through model.newThread(), model.newThread(workspace: .worktree) and model.newThread(in: project)
Opens a folder chooser panel indirectly via model.chooseProjectFolder() (the add-project row)
Opens the Settings window via WindowManager.shared.showSettings()
Toggles per-thread runtime state: runtime.isTerminalVisible and runtime.toggleDiff()
Runs the thread finish action via model.finishSelectedThread()
No direct file writes, process launches, network calls, timers or keychain access in this file
platform_assumptions: SwiftUI on macOS with Observation-based @Environment(AppModel.self) environment lookup
glassEffect(.regular, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 24, style: .continuous)) is the macOS 26 Liquid Glass material API
onKeyPress(.upArrow / .downArrow / .escape) assumes a hardware keyboard; onHover assumes a mouse pointer, so the palette expects a desktop pointer plus keyboard
SF Symbols names: magnifyingglass, square.and.pencil, arrow.triangle.branch, folder.badge.plus, terminal, plusminus, gearshape, bubble.left, folder
Uses .tint / AnyShapeStyle(.tint) which resolves to the macOS accent color, plus the .secondary and .tertiary hierarchical styles
ignoresSafeArea() on the scrim assumes the palette is hosted as a full-window overlay
persisted_fields: None declared in this file. The chords shown in the shortcut column come from ShortcutStore.label(for:), whose persistence lives elsewhere; the in-file comment states the column shows nothing at all once a chord is cleared, so label(for:) yields no text for an unbound action.
ui_elements: Scrim: Color.black.opacity(colorScheme == .dark ? 0.24 : 0.08), .ignoresSafeArea(), .contentShape(.rect), tap closes the palette, .accessibilityHidden(true)

Search row: HStack(spacing: 10) of Image(systemName: "magnifyingglass").foregroundStyle(.secondary) and TextField with placeholder text exactly "Search threads, projects and actions"; .textFieldStyle(.plain), .font(.title3); row padding .horizontal 18, .vertical 15

Empty state text: Nothing matches “<query>” using curly quotation marks, .font(.system(size: 13)), .foregroundStyle(.secondary), .lineLimit(1), .truncationMode(.middle), .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading), .padding(.horizontal, 18), .padding(.bottom, 16)
Results list: VStack(spacing: 2) inside .padding(.horizontal, 6) and .padding(.bottom, 6); ForEach over Array(items.enumerated()) keyed by \.element.id

Row layout: HStack(spacing: 12); leading icon Group with .frame(width: 18) showing ProjectIconMark(icon: item.icon, size: 13) when item.icon != nil, else Image(systemName: item.symbol) tinted AnyShapeStyle(.tint) when selected and AnyShapeStyle(.secondary) otherwise
Row text: VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 1); title Text .lineLimit(1); optional subtitle Text .font(.caption) .foregroundStyle(.secondary) .lineLimit(1) .truncationMode(.middle)
Row trailing: Spacer(minLength: 8) then optional shortcut Text .font(.caption) .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)

Row chrome: .padding(.horizontal, 12), .padding(.vertical, 8), background AnyShapeStyle(.tint.opacity(0.16)) when selected else AnyShapeStyle(Color.clear), in .rect(cornerRadius: 12, style: .continuous), .contentShape(.rect)
Action row titles exactly: "New thread", "New thread in worktree", "Add project", "Toggle terminal", "Toggle changes", model.finishActionTitle (dynamic), "Settings"
Project row title template: "New thread in <project.name>", subtitle project.path, icon project.icon, symbol "folder"
feature_notes: Rows are rebuilt only when ResultsKey changes (query, model.threads, model.projects, model.selectedThreadID, model.finishActionTitle) with initial: true, so arrow-key movement and hover selection never recompute the list.
onAppear sets isFocused = true so the search field takes focus as soon as the palette appears; onChange(of: query) resets selection to 0.

Up arrow: selection = max(0, selection - 1). Down arrow: selection = min(max(0, items.count - 1), selection + 1). Both return .handled, so the clamp never runs past the ends. Escape calls close() and returns .handled. Return (onSubmit) runs the selected row.
Hovering a row sets selection to that index, deliberately so the pointer and the arrow keys never disagree about what Return will run; tapping a row sets selection then runs it.
run(_:) guards items.indices.contains(selection), calls close() FIRST and only then item.perform(), so the palette is always dismissed before the action fires.
close() only sets model.isCommandPalettePresented = false; tapping the scrim and pressing Escape both route through it.

Base action set, always present, in this order: new-thread ("New thread", square.and.pencil, ShortcutStore.label(for: .newThread), model.newThread()); new-worktree ("New thread in worktree", arrow.triangle.branch, .newWorktreeThread, model.newThread(workspace: .worktree)); add-project ("Add project", folder.badge.plus, .addProject, model.chooseProjectFolder()).

Thread-dependent actions are appended only when model.selectedThreadID is non-nil: terminal ("Toggle terminal", terminal, .toggleTerminal, runtime.isTerminalVisible.toggle()); changes ("Toggle changes", plusminus, .toggleChanges, runtime.toggleDiff()); finish (title model.finishActionTitle, symbol model.finishActionSymbol, .finishThread, model.finishSelectedThread()).
settings ("Settings", gearshape, .openSettings, WindowManager.shared.showSettings()) is appended last and is always present, after the conditional thread actions.
needle = query.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).lowercased(). Actions are filtered by title.lowercased().contains(needle) only when the needle is non-empty; with an empty needle all actions pass.

Thread rows drop isArchived and isInPanel threads, match on title.lowercased().contains(needle), sort by updatedAt descending, and take prefix(6) with an empty query or prefix(10) while searching. Subtitle is model.project(thread.projectID)?.name, symbol "bubble.left", id is thread.id.uuidString, and running it sets model.selectedThreadID = thread.id.

Project rows are suppressed entirely when the query is empty; otherwise every project whose name.lowercased() contains the needle becomes a row with id project.id.uuidString calling model.newThread(in: project).

Ordering differs by mode: with an empty query the list is Array(threads) + matchingActions (recent threads first); with a non-empty query it is matchingActions + Array(threads) + projects. The combined list is then truncated with prefix(12).
Shortcut labels come from ShortcutStore rather than hard-coded strings, so a remapped chord shows the new keys and a cleared chord shows no shortcut text at all.
The empty-results branch never leaves a blank box: it renders the single-line Nothing matches message with the query echoed inside curly quotes and middle truncation.
unresolved_questions: The concrete type returned by model.runtime(for:) and whether isTerminalVisible / toggleDiff() persist anything is defined outside this file.

The return type of ShortcutStore.label(for:) (String vs String?) cannot be confirmed here; Item.shortcut is String? and labels are passed straight through, which implies optional, but the declaration lives in another file.
The exact values of model.finishActionTitle and model.finishActionSymbol, and how they vary with thread state, are not visible in this file.
Where CommandPalette is mounted in the view hierarchy, and hence what glassEffect and ignoresSafeArea actually cover, is not shown here; only model.isCommandPalettePresented is referenced.
No scrolling is applied to the results VStack, so with the full 12 rows the panel simply grows; whether an enclosing container clips or scrolls it is not determinable from this file.
